items.title: Robot Arena Kit enters exploration
items.text: A robot sumo kit for young coders is now in the exploration phase. No sales, no prices; feasibility comes first.

items.title: Agent Organisation published
items.text: Every daily job now has a named role, a deadline and a reporting line. See who drafts, who checks and who audits.

items.title: Live Work Status is live
items.text: An independent checker marks each daily deliverable against its deadline four times a day. Misses stay on the record.

items.title: Net load outlook gets a chart
items.text: The Türkiye next-day outlook now ships with an animated net load chart alongside the post.
